summary: Iteration 7 - PHP Web Installer (install.php) fully tested. All 23 backend tests passed. PHP syntax valid, all AJAX endpoints working correctly, HTML rendering verified, lock mechanism functional.

check_lock_endpoint: check_lock returns valid JSON with ok=true
check_lock returns locked=false when no lock file exists
check_lock returns locked=true when .install_lock file exists
check_system_endpoint: check_system returns valid JSON with checks object
check_system reports project files status (backend, frontend, requirements)
html_rendering: GET request returns HTML content type
HTML contains step cards (step-0 through step-6)
HTML contains form fields (cfgDomain, cfgAdminEmail, cfgAdminPass, cfgMongoUrl)
setup_backend_endpoint: setup_backend creates .env file with correct MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, CORS_ORIGINS
lock_mechanism: Lock file blocks other actions (check_system returns error when locked)
check_lock still works even when locked
error_handling: Unknown action returns error with ok=false
setup_services_endpoint: setup_services returns ok=true with steps array (partial success expected in test env)

Lock mechanism prevents re-installation. JavaScript validation catches form errors. Note: setup_services and some system commands will partially fail in test environment due to no systemd - this is expected.

php_installer.description: PHP Web Installer for taxi service 'Ryadom' - replaces bash install.sh with browser UI
ajax_endpoints: check_system - returns system status (nodejs, python3, mongodb, nginx, project files)
install_deps - installs missing components (nodejs, python3, mongodb, nginx)
setup_services - creates systemd service and nginx config

test_environment_notes: PHP server started with: cd /app && php -S 0.0.0.0:9090. Lock file at /app/.install_lock. Cleanup: rm -f /app/.install_lock
